contact.title: Umbuzo Ojwayelekile
contact.body: Thumela imibuzo ejwayelekile ngokusebenzisa isevisi, ama-akhawunti, nokuboniswa kwedatha.
contact.bizBody: Thumela iziphakamiso zebhizinisi ezihlanganisa ukukhangisa, ukuhlanganiswa kwamapulatifomu, nobambiswano lokuqukethwe.
contact.bugBody: Bika amaphutha, izinkinga zesakhiwo, noma okungajwayelekile ekubonisiweni kwedatha.
